summary: Temporal Server depends on multiple archived and deprecated Go libraries including AWS SDK v1 (end-of-support July 2025), olivere/elastic (deprecated in favor of official Elasticsearch client), and several other outdated direct and indirect dependencies. Upgrading to maintained replacements is necessary to avoid security and compatibility issues.
userImpact: Users are at risk from unpatched security vulnerabilities and compatibility issues due to reliance on archived and deprecated libraries that no longer receive updates.
rootCause: Temporal Server has not kept pace with upstream library deprecation and archival cycles, particularly AWS SDK v1 (archived July 2025) and oliviere/elastic (explicitly deprecated by maintainer).
proposedFix: Upgrade AWS SDK to v2, replace oliviere/elastic with official elastic/go-elasticsearch, migrate pkg/errors to stdlib errors, update mitchellh/mapstructure to go-viper fork, upgrade jwt/v4 to v5, gocql to Apache fork v2, and consolidate urfave/cli versions. Replace archived indirect dependencies like gogo/protobuf and golang/mock with recommended alternatives.
keyQuote: This repository was archived by the owner on Jul 31, 2025... This SDK has reached end-of-support. It will not receive further updates.
